name: Kawasaki Vulcan Mean Streak
engine: 1470 or 1552 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Kawasaki's performance cruiser. Fuel injected, with better brakes and suspension than the other Vulcans of its day.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2003-2004 Mean Streaks are in recall 04V023 for an oil filter that can deform on a cold start.

recalls.years: 2003-2004 (some Classic, Drifter, Mean Streak, Nomad FI)
recalls.what: High oil pressure on a cold start can deform the oil filter cartridge.

forums.name: Vulcan Riders Association
